name: signal_tower_structure_concept_sheet_v1
description: T-0226 -- Signal Tower structure/traversal concept sheet: Records Room shelving, ladder, Power Substation catwalk/grating, and door. Fills the four asset-set gaps found by the T-0226 audit against the material sheet (T-0167), player sheet (T-0209), entity sheet (T-0210), and props sheet (T-0211). img2img+LoRA, conditioned on signal_tower_material_sheet.png (the Signal Tower archetype's first approved sheet) per the archetype-first coherence guard (13-asset-pipeline.md:313-319) -- the first submission of this sheet was a bare txt2img prompt and was rejected in review for both violating that guard and rendering a receding-perspective scene instead of flat elevation panels.
prompt: flat side-on structural/traversal concept reference sheet, orthographic game asset, no perspective, no vanishing point, no room, no scene, Signal Tower interior structural elements shown as flat elevation silhouettes arranged in four labeled panels on a plain background, matching the flat side-on framing of the reference material sheet. PANEL ONE - RECORDS ROOM SHELVING: tall dense records-office shelving row, stacked document boxes and binders on open shelf frames, narrow aisle gap, mid-value concrete-grey shelf frame with darker document-box silhouettes. PANEL TWO - LADDER: vertical steel rung ladder mounted flush to a wall section, evenly spaced horizontal rungs, narrow uprights, free-standing traversal object. PANEL THREE - CATWALK / GRATING: short elevated metal grating platform section with a simple guard railing along one edge, industrial perforated-grate floor texture, side-on elevation. PANEL FOUR - DOOR: single flat steel branch door in a plain frame, closed, side-on elevation, simple handle and seam detail, free-standing door object matching the vertical connector's same status as a normal door. Soviet brutalist Signal Tower interior, muted concrete grey and institutional green and near-black palette, hard value separation, flat unlit shading, no atmospheric haze, no depth of field, structural silhouette study, game asset reference sheet style, no background scene composition, no walls receding into the distance, no floor plane, no ceiling
